name: Document Adjustment 1
definition: Set of elements used to provide information on the amount and reason of the document adjustment.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money of the document adjustment.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the adjustment must be subtracted or added to the total amount.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Specifies the reason for the adjustment.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides further details on the document adjustment.
